title: Find sites for a 100 MW data center
summary: Inyokern’s filing lists 99 MW of facility demand and 70 MW for IT. At Ellendale, the operator reports 100 MW for IT in its first building.
evidence: California Energy Commission docket and Applied Digital filings
workflowLabel: Share your MW and service dates

title: Check a building’s wildfire exposure
summary: Two address points at Griffith Observatory returned the same wildfire zone. Only one point landed on the building footprint.
evidence: County building footprints and CAL FIRE maps

title: Trace a parcel’s boundary history
summary: A Brooklyn tax lot kept its ID after a split and retained about 53% of its former mapped area.
evidence: New York City tax lot records and maps

title: Review debt recorded against a property
summary: A $415 million agreement and a rent assignment at 25 Water Street carry the same amount. The recorder links them to the same financing.
evidence: New York City recorder and parcel records
workflowLabel: See what you can check across a portfolio

title: Check a feeder’s load headroom
summary: A New York feeder shows 3.18 MVA of summer load headroom, 4.98 MVA in winter, and a separate 0.10 MW solar export figure.
workflowLabel: See what a power study can verify

title: Estimate the reach of a second store
summary: At a 15-minute drive, a model estimates 31,200 Detroit-area households can reach both stores and 150,300 can only reach the second.
evidence: Census estimates and Valhalla drive areas
workflowLabel: Estimate reach for your own locations
